Programmable physical control devices are increasingly becoming key to advanced user workflows, including agentic coding. Logitech is now bringing a compact solution to market that fits on any desk.

Logitech today announced the MX Keypad, a $99.99 accessory featuring nine customizable full-color LCD keys for launching commands, executing macros, and accessing AI tools.

The MX Keypad is priced at half the cost of the Logitech MX Creative Console

If the hardware looks familiar, there's a good reason for that. The Logitech MX Creative Console pairs an LCD keypad with a separate dial controller for adjusting settings and navigating in creative applications.

The MX Keypad delivers that keypad experience without the additional controller, at half the price of the Creative Console's $199.99 price tag.

The new product is aimed at developers and AI workflows, though the customization isn't limited to coding applications.

Customizing the experience with the Logi Options+ app

Through the free Logi Options+ app, users can assign keyboard shortcuts, saved prompts, scripts, and macros to individual keys. Two page keys can provide up to 15 pages, and app-specific profiles automatically switch layouts when you change applications.

This means the same physical keys can serve different functions in VS Code, Slack, Chrome, or other apps. The Logi Marketplace offers plugins, profiles, and icon packs, while a built-in icon editor lets users customize the appearance of each key.

You can use AI to program your AI keypad

My initial hands-on test involved connecting the MX Keypad to my MacBook Air on my desk, then asking Codex with computer-use capabilities to programmatically customize the keys based on how I use ChatGPT on Mac.

Using an AI coding agent to set up a physical control device meant for AI work is rather poetic, and it clearly demonstrates the pitch: putting your frequently repeated prompts and actions onto dedicated, labeled keys.

Logitech partnered with GitHub to develop the MX Keypad. The product includes GitHub Copilot integration for VS Code, along with three months of free Copilot Pro+, available to both new and existing users via Logi Options+.

MX Keypad supports community plugins

Logitech also noted that community plugins for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex can offer features like agent status tracking and terminal control. Developers who want to go further can use the Logi Actions SDK, which supports C# and Node.js, to build custom plugins.

The keypad connects via USB-C and requires macOS 13 or later, or Windows 10 or later. It measures approximately 3.6 x 3.1 inches and weighs 96 grams, so it won't take up much space next to a laptop or keyboard.

The MX Keypad goes on sale today (September 8) in Graphite and Pale Gray color options, priced at $99.99.
